claim: WeWork successfully completed its initial IPO in 2019.
Tesla delivered its one millionth electric vehicle in March 2020.
Notion raised a Series C funding round in 2020 at a $2 billion valuation.
label_note: Corrected 2026-09-11 from SUPPORTS. Notion's April 2020 raise was $50M at a $2B valuation (TechCrunch, Axios, Apr 1-2 2020) and was not reported as a Series C; its Series C was the $275M round of October 2021. The claim joins a true valuation to the wrong round, so it is false as written. Surfaced when the verifier returned REFUTES citing exactly this evidence.
